_comment: Registry of reference files kept in the 'source-archive' GitHub release instead of the repository. Edit by hand to add a file: give 'fetch' (an official download address) or 'manual' (why it must be attached by hand), and 'sha256' of the copy that was checked, if known. 'zip' builds one zip from several downloads, each checked against its own sha256. The 'Archive sources to release' workflow (run from the Actions tab) downloads, checks and uploads; results go to release-manifest.json. See sources/README.md.
